subject: Sales touchpoint platform evaluation & security gaps
messages:
From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@outreach.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window + SSO & retention alignment for BrightLayer

Hi Connor —

Hope you're well. Our records show your Outreach subscription for BrightLayer comes up for renewal on 2027-06-15. I wanted to start a quick thread to align on (a) seat counts, (b) SAML SSO config and (c) data retention / export requirements before we issue the renewal quote.

Quick questions to help us scope:
- Do you plan to keep current active seats or do a consolidation? Any expected headcount changes through Q3?
- Is BrightLayer using a corporate IdP via SAML for SSO today? If so, which provider (Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin)?
- Do you have any regulatory/data retention constraints for activity logs and exports (e.g., 7 years vs 1 year)?

I can pull a draft quote once we understand seats and retention. I’m copying our procurement mailbox so we can route PO/contract deliverables straight there.

Attaching: Outreach_renewal_quote_Q2.pdf (initial term template) and security_config_sheet.xlsx.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call this week if that helps.

Best,
Sarah Miller
Enterprise AE | Outreach
sarah.miller@outreach.io | (415) 555-0199

Attachments: Outreach_renewal_quote_Q2.pdf, security_config_sheet.xlsx
From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@outreach.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + SSO & retention alignment for BrightLayer

Sarah —

Thanks for the heads up. A few notes from BrightLayer side so we can get you a clean SOW/quote:

- Seat plan: We're planning to reduce active Outreach seats by ~20% starting July (consolidating low-usage SDR seats). I need a usage export to confirm exact seat ids — Ben, can you attach last quarter usage?
- SSO: BrightLayer uses Okta for everything (SAML 2.0). We will need explicit confirmation that Okta SSO is supported for admin and non-admin roles and that role mappings can be controlled via SCIM provisioning.
- Retention: Legal requires 3 years of activity logs for audit. We need a documented retention plan and what the export process looks like if we decide to exit.

If Outreach can provide an updated quote that reflects a 12-month term with net-new consolidated seat count and support for Okta SCIM, that will speed approvals. Also loop in procurement@outreach.io for contract redlines.

Connor O'Brien
Head of Sales Ops | BrightLayer
connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0132

Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal window + SSO & retention alignment for BrightLayer

Hi Connor / Marissa —

Thanks for the specifics. We can support Okta SAML and SCIM provisioning; SCIM provisioning for groups/roles is available on our Enterprise tier. We do have the ability to export three years of activity logs — exports are provided as CSV/JSON, and we can schedule a quarterly archive if you prefer.

Regarding the quote: we've prepared two options attached to this email — 1) "Consolidated" reflecting a 20% seat reduction (12-month term) and 2) "Status quo" (renewal at current counts). The Consolidated option includes a one-time provisioning setup fee and discounted rate for seats we reassign.

Attachments: Outreach_renewal_quote_Q2.pdf (updated), security_config_sheet.xlsx

If you'd like, we can route the contract via DocuSign — I included a preview link here: https://docusign.com/en/doc/preview/ABC123-outreach-quote

Let us know which option you'd like to pursue and any required PO/GL details.

Best,
Outreach Procurement Team
procurement@outreach.io
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: RE: Renewal window + SSO & retention alignment for BrightLayer

Connor / Marissa — forwarding Outreach's options. Quick notes after I ran the seat usage export (attached): BrightLayer_seat_usage_Mar2027.csv shows ~18 seats appearing dormant (below 5% active usage last 90 days).

My recommendation: go with the "Consolidated" quote but:
- Push for SCIM provisioning SLA (make the provisioning setup part of the SOW).
- Ask for a 6-month payment term for the one-time setup fee.
- Negotiate a flexible seat add-on rate in case we need to scale back up quickly (same per-seat price, prorated).

If we approve that path, I can draft the internal PO and route to Finance.

Ben Carter
Director, Revenue Operations | BrightLayer
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: BrightLayer_seat_usage_Mar2027.csv

Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + SSO & retention alignment for BrightLayer

Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the two quote scenarios. We’ll proceed with the "Consolidated" option assuming the following items are explicit in the SOW/contract before Finance issues the PO:

1) SCIM provisioning included (Okta integration) with a 5-business-day setup SLA and rollback plan.
2) Three-year activity-log exports available on-demand; quarterly archive delivery included.
3) One-time provisioning setup fee amortized over the 12-month term (Finance prefers monthly charge) and a six-month payment window for that fee.
4) Flexible add-on seat pricing at the same per-seat rate, prorated for partial months.

Please send an updated PDF quote and a DocuSign-ready contract reflecting the items above and list the contact for technical onboarding. We aim to get PO to you by 2027-05-10.

Connor O'Brien
Head of Sales Ops | BrightLayer
connor_obrien@redwoodinference.com
